description.narrative: The UNFPA Supplies Partnership is a thematic fund that facilitates expanded access to high quality contraceptives and medicines used for maternal health. - The UNFPA Supplies Partnership is a thematic fund that facilitates expanded access to high quality contraceptives and medicines used for maternal health. Access to a choice of quality-assured contraceptive methods is essential to sexual and reproductive health and rights, including the ability to plan, space, and prevent pregnancy. The Partnership procures commodities at scale and works with governments and civil society partners to strengthen health systems. In Mozambique, the Ministry of Health have an MoU with UNFPA to procure contraceptives with the State budget, through the Supplies Partnership. The grant from Ireland will support the Mozambican Government to increase availability of quality contraceptives, which has multiple direct and indirect benefits.
